title: Ed May worked with Prince Hans-Adam

tellings.quote: He talks about working with the Royal Prince of Liechtenstein, Hans Adam.

plain: A researcher named Ed May, who worked on Stargate, a US government programme that studied whether people could use psychic powers to spy, is said to have worked with the reigning prince of Liechtenstein, Hans-Adam II. Michels says May talks about this himself, and he passes it on without saying what the work was.
